meta.name: assessing-impact
meta.description: Pre-change blast-radius report for a symbol or file. Walks tree-sitting references, augments with a plain-text scan over non-parsed files (configs, plain docs), and clusters affected sites by feature (`_FEATURES.md`) or top-level package. Use when about to refactor, rename, or delete something in a repo you don't own — "what breaks if I change `validateUser`", "who calls this", "is this safe to remove", "where is this used", "blast radius", "impact analysis". This is the CONVERGENT pre-change risk skill — for "what is this repo?" use exploring-codebases; for "where is X?" use searching-codebases.

copy.tagline: 改代码前先查影响范围，避免意外破坏。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要在不熟悉的仓库里改代码，想知道哪些地方会受影响。
